themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize native-born citizens in public services, housing, and welfare. This theme reflects a shared rhetorical and legislative strategy to restrict benefits for immigrants and reinforce nationalist agendas, appearing in multiple countries with varying degrees of intensity and legislative success.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in public aid and housing, passing motions in municipalities like Mijas and Valencia with PP support.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini and Lega advocate for stricter immigration controls and prioritization of Italian citizens in social services.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes retaining private health insurance if it strengthens public healthcare, reflecting a focus on national over immigrant access.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Demands veto rights for Sametinget to block motorized traffic agreements, emphasizing indigenous and national priorities.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes multiculturalism and advocates for policies favoring French citizens in welfare and public services.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina’s President Javier Milei faces growing unpopularity due to economic austerity, corruption scandals, and internal conflicts within his party. This theme resonates in right-wing media across Latin America and Europe, where Milei’s libertarian experiment is closely watched and often criticized by allies and opponents alike.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei’s approval rating drops to 33% amid economic struggles, corruption scandals, and internal party conflicts.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Milei’s economic policies and corruption scandals, framing them as failures of libertarian governance.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Right-wing media highlights Milei’s struggles as a cautionary tale for libertarian policies, contrasting with Trump’s economic narrative.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Monitors Milei’s economic policies and internal conflicts, often comparing them to Italy’s own political challenges.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties are making significant electoral gains in local and regional elections across Europe, often capitalizing on anti-immigration sentiment, economic dissatisfaction, and opposition to EU policies. This theme reflects a broader trend of right-wing resurgence in subnational politics.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt, Mecklenburg-West Pomerania, and Berlin, with 70% of Germans expecting an AfD state premier.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Wins key administrative elections in Liguria and other regions, consolidating right-wing control.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains influence in regional governments, such as Andalusia and Castilla y León, through coalitions with PP.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to influence Swedish politics, particularly in healthcare and immigration policies.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factional infighting. These conflicts often revolve around ideological purity, strategic alliances, and personal rivalries, threatening party cohesion and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faces internal strife between hardliners like Czarnek and moderates like Morawiecki, risking a damaging split.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza Party challenges Fidesz’s dominance, leading to internal conflicts and leadership disputes.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Struggles with internal power struggles, including Nigel Farage’s leadership and defections to rival parties like Restore Britain.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Faces internal debates over strategy, including alliances with other right-wing factions and leadership challenges.

themes.title: EU and NATO tensions over Ukraine and migration
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe are increasingly critical of EU and NATO policies on Ukraine and migration, advocating for reduced military support to Ukraine and stricter border controls. This theme reflects a broader skepticism toward transnational alliances and a push for national sovereignty in defense and immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Criticizes EU’s Ukraine policy, with Salvini opposing military aid and advocating for peace negotiations.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Opposes Ukraine’s EU accession and criticizes Zelensky’s policies, threatening to revoke his Order of the White Eagle.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Maintains a pro-Russia stance, opposing EU sanctions and military aid to Ukraine.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Advocates for stricter border controls and opposes EU migration policies, framing them as threats to national sovereignty.
